truncation_confound.caveat: The k=20 criteria block DISPLACES document text on this cell: truncation rises from 0.021 (raw text) to 0.298 (with block) at max_len. Placement is PREPEND so the block always survives, but on those rows the tail of the document is cut that the raw/T arm kept. The V3 and T arms therefore did NOT see the same text. A V3 <= T result on this cell is NOT interpretable as 'the criteria block does not help' without a matched-n raw-text control arm; the confound runs in the direction of making V3 look worse.
